betu_spot: Betu (from afar): Look Bholu! The hat-seller uncle! Let's buy hats too!
betu_tell: Betu: Uncle, don't worry! The monkeys took your hats. Look, on top of the tree!
bholu_pick: Bholu: Yes! Which color hat will you take, Betu? I'll take the blue one!
catch_instruction: Drag the red hat down to the ground! Then tap the falling hats to catch them!
collect: Everyone collected the hats together and gave them to the hat seller.
dance_instruction: Press the Jump button! Watch, do the monkeys copy us?
dream_1: The hat seller fell asleep and dreamed: I'll sell lots of hats! I'll take money and mangoes home, and have fun with my family.
first_sale: The hat seller smiled: You are such kind children! Here are your hats.
gift_offer: Hat seller: Thank you so much! Keep these two hats.
goodbye: Betu and Bholu waved: Goodbye, hat-seller uncle!
idea: Bholu: Uncle, I have an idea! Monkeys are copycats. They imitate us!
monkeys_copy: Wow! The monkeys threw their hats down too!
monkeys_steal: Oh no! As soon as the hat seller fell asleep, the monkeys came down the tree! Each monkey took one hat and sat on top of the tree!
picker_title: Choose hats for Betu and Bholu!
polite_refuse: Betu: No thank you, uncle! We want to buy the hats. Let your first sale be to us!
reprise: The hat seller walked on, singing: Hats for sale! Red-yellow hats for sale, green-blue hats for sale!
rest_think: The hat seller thinks: I'll rest here a while. I'll eat mangoes, drink water, rest my hands and feet, then take a short nap.
shade: What cool shade under the tree, and what a lovely breeze is blowing!
test_plan: Betu: First let's jump and dance and see whether they copy us!
throw_ask: Betu: Uncle, now throw your hat on the ground!
topi_song_1: The hat seller sings: Hats for sale! Hats for sale!
topi_song_2: Red-yellow hats for sale, green-blue hats for sale!
tree_spot: Oh! What a big mango tree! And so many monkeys on top!
validated: Look! The monkeys are jumping too! The trick will work!
wake: The hat seller woke up: Oh! Where did my hats go?
worry: Without my hats, how will I earn money? How will I go home?
